scope: P4-01 current macOS development host, source, real AppKit/WKWebView e2e, build rollback, visual output, source freshness

findings.issue: Native forced default data root bypassed existing legacy data resolution/migration
findings.resolution: Leave direct serve environment resolution in place, match runtime by owned PID in next/legacy roots, retain empty and relative path semantics

findings.issue: Failed replacement plus failed restoration deleted the only old App during staging cleanup
findings.resolution: Preserve previous.app on double rename failure, report recovery path, add fault injection

findings.issue: Default WebKit profile shared localStorage across business data roots
findings.resolution: Use macOS14 named persistent website data stores keyed by canonical data root, test same-origin cross-root isolation and same-root persistence

findings.issue: Window movement notification could overwrite frame before restoration
findings.resolution: Restore before attaching movement delegate; test a visible non-default frame

findings.issue: Strict origin navigation cancelled sandboxed srcdoc previews
findings.resolution: Allow about:srcdoc/about:blank only in child frames; retain trusted-origin top-frame policy

findings.issue: Lock acquisition failure skipped lifecycle callbacks and Retry did not reacquire lock
findings.resolution: Install common callbacks/menu/signals before locking, Retry reacquires lock; actual CUA button press recovers complete UI

findings.issue: Foundation path alias differed from Node POSIX canonical identity
findings.resolution: Use POSIX realpath with nearest existing ancestor for profile/lock identity

findings.issue: AppKit terminateLater nested loop prevented main-queue service cleanup callbacks
findings.resolution: Cancel initial termination, finish async owned service cleanup, then terminateNow under completed shutdown flag

limits: Formal Developer ID identity/Keychain/TCC revalidation deferred by user
System bridge, notifications and media pending P4-02/P4-03
MCP/CLI full process trees and sleep/wake pending P4-04
Development App resources depend on workbench source directory
